'''Kelarea''' was an object<ref name="RC" /> located in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], around [[21 BBY/Legends|367 days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start of the conflict]], the [[Majestic (Acclamator-class)|''Majestic'']] traveled to Kelarea after it recovered the wreckage of [[TIV Z590/1]] and the body of [[Sicko/Legends|CT-1127/549]]. The [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel]] and the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] were both lost during a [[Traffic Interdiction Operations|TIOPS]] [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|mission]] conducted by [[Omega Squad]] at the nearby [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]&ndash;[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection.<ref name="RC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kelarea was first mentioned<ref name="RC" /> in the novel ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', which was written by [[Karen Traviss]] and released in [[2006]].<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/f20060228/index.html|text=''Republic Commando: Triple Zero'' Excerpt}}</ref> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Kelarea system/Legends|Kelarea star system]] and the object itself in grid square N-14.<ref name="EAOC" />

==Appearances==
